title: AW27 Women's Knit Shape and Fit Outlook
summary: Knits for AW27 women: marl jumpers, fine merino under tailoring, kidult and whimsical knits, and tight, silky wool knits.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Boland sees the upper body widening (80s shoulders, broad chests) over narrower trousers or skirts; key items include the skirt suit, broad-shouldered and reversible double-faced coats, camouflage parka and marl jumper<sup>[1]</sup>
- Separable double-faced woollens return in more varied weights; ultrafine yarns and tight knits make wool lighter and softer, with thermal comfort without synthetics<sup>[2]</sup>
- Woolmark presented merino wool as "the technical fibre" for AW27 sourcing at Pitti Filati<sup>[3]</sup>
- FashionUnited notes "kidult" knitwear with whimsical faces and regressive animal motifs and a customer raised on Y2K who buys playful charms<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: Shapes and fit
sections.body:
- **Marl crew** with a slightly broad shoulder.
- **Fine merino polo and turtleneck** for layering.
- **Knit dress** in tight, smooth wool.
- **Whimsical intarsia** for a younger customer.

design_implications: - Ultrafine yarns for a silky hand.
